answer: Re-attestations are stored in jetty and yarrow lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 10 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the juniper graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1809 impostors cost 563 times the honest price and take 27 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
